name: hex-compiler
description: Magic is fading. You're a Hex Compiler—translating magical hexes into hexadecimal code. An idle game about compiling spells into data and building digital preservation chambers.

scripts.size-check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d='dist/js';const crit=fs.statSync(p.join(d,'game.bundle.js')).size;const all=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).reduce((s,f)=>s+fs.statSync(p.join(d,f)).size,0);const ck=(crit/1024).toFixed(1),ak=(all/1024).toFixed(1);console.log('Critical bundle: '+ck+'KB | Total (with lazy chunks): '+ak+'KB');if(crit>200*1024){console.error('FAIL: critical bundle exceeds 200KB budget');process.exit(1);}else{console.log('PASS: critical bundle within 200KB budget');}"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run lint:color-debt && npm run typecheck && npm run test
